resolved.title: Agent-scoping RLS policies compare users.id FKs against auth.uid()
resolved.resolution_es: Opción A aplicada (migración 08): realineado users.id = auth_user_id en producción (admin), repuntada la fila de whatsapp_numbers que lo referenciaba, restaurada la FK ON DELETE CASCADE, y añadido trigger BEFORE INSERT enforce_user_id_equals_auth() que fija id = auth_user_id en cada alta. create-agent ahora inserta id = auth uid. Verificado: all_ids_aligned=true, 0 filas huérfanas. Las políticas `<fk> = auth.uid()` ya coinciden para agentes.
resolved.resolution_en: Option A applied (migration 08): realigned users.id = auth_user_id in production (admin row), repointed the referencing whatsapp_numbers row, restored the ON DELETE CASCADE FK, and added a BEFORE INSERT trigger enforce_user_id_equals_auth() that pins id = auth_user_id on every insert. create-agent now inserts id = auth uid. Verified: all_ids_aligned=true, 0 orphan rows. Agent-scoping `<fk> = auth.uid()` policies now match.

resolved.title: Legacy FastAPI backend unused by dashboard
resolved.resolution_es: Auditoría confirmó que ningún servicio vivo consume el backend FastAPI (prod = Netlify + Supabase Edge Functions + whatsapp-gateway slim). Eliminados backend/ (91 archivos), gateway/ viejo (8), código muerto del dashboard (api.ts + proxy /api en next.config.js) y docker-compose.yml. Actualizados README.md y .env.example a la arquitectura Fase 8.
resolved.resolution_en: Audit confirmed no live service consumes the FastAPI backend (prod = Netlify + Supabase Edge Functions + slim whatsapp-gateway). Removed backend/ (91 files), legacy gateway/ (8), dashboard dead code (api.ts + /api proxy in next.config.js) and docker-compose.yml. Updated README.md and .env.example to Fase 8 architecture.
